title: List notebook dataframes
description: The dataframes and DuckDB tables the notebook's kernel currently holds — what a SQL or Python cell can reference by name — with column names/types and row counts, plus the kernel's live status and compute config. Frames are empty unless the kernel is running (SQL-only notebooks never start one; frames appear after Python/DuckDB cells run). To probe deeper than the schema, run a SELECT in a cell. Only a modal backend is charged: hourly_price is calculated for a local docker kernel too, so quote it to the user only when backend is modal.

methodDocumentation.text: Live-checked kernel runtime state for this notebook, its compute configuration, and the catalog of dataframes/tables a cell can currently reference (with column schemas).
